name: Romance
entries: Slow dance: two people facing each other at close range, one hand of each joined at shoulder height and their free hands resting at the other's upper back or shoulder, both supporting their own weight.
One person leaning forward to kiss the other person's forehead while the other tilts their head slightly down, both standing with their feet planted.
Two people walking side by side with their inner hands joined loosely between them, leaving space for both to step forward.
Two people seated side by side with shoulders touching, one resting their head against the other's shoulder while both remain supported by the seat.
Two people facing each other in an embrace, their arms around each other's upper backs and their heads turned slightly aside.
One person standing in front of the other and fastening a necklace at the back of their neck, the other holding their hair clear with one hand.
Two people seated across a small table, one resting an open hand on the surface while the other lays their hand gently over it.
Two people reclining side by side with their heads on separate cushions, turned toward each other and holding hands in the space between them.
One person seated while the other kneels beside them to offer a small wrapped gift, both looking toward the gift between them.
Two people standing side by side beneath a shared umbrella, one holding its handle between them while the other rests a hand on the holder's forearm.
